text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Use of multi-paragraph essay structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"Structural Organization","description":"Captures the ability to organize writing into distinct paragraphs with clear narrative or argumentative progression."},{"evidence":"Clear expression of reasonings, such as helping shy older students practice communication or assisting students whose parents cannot help","quality":"Coherence of Ideas","description":"Captures the writer's ability to communicate comprehensible, logical thoughts and supporting details."},{"evidence":"Correct formation of sentences using subordinate clauses like 'Because younger students look up to the older students'","quality":"Syntactic Complexity","description":"Captures the use of varied and complex grammatical structures rather than fragmented or incoherent strings of words."},{"evidence":"Use of precise vocabulary such as 'communicate', 'strategy', and 'pursue your teaching career'","quality":"Vocabulary Range","description":"Captures the appropriate deployment of domain-relevant words and expressive language."},{"evidence":"Demonstration of fundamental English mechanics despite minor spelling and punctuation errors","quality":"Control of Conventions","description":"Captures the writer's command over standard English spelling, punctuation, and capitalization to maintain readability."}]}
